items.label: Inspect the Editor fixture boot path and async backend document loading path.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor `src/app/EditorApp.tsx` and backend transport contracts identify where fixture and backend states diverge.
items.verificationNote: Editor docs/EDITOR_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE_HONESTY_REVIEW.md records the fixture boot path, Backend capability preflight, Backend document read path, and Preview context transport boundary. Backend capability unavailable keeps fixture visible and Backend-owned operations disabled.

items.label: Verify that visible status language separates loaded backend documents from unavailable, unsupported, partial, stale, and blocked states.
items.evidenceTarget: Component or browser evidence shows product UI state labels for backend-unavailable and non-fresh core envelopes.
items.verificationNote: Component render tests prove fixture fallback Preview unavailable/checking states route through PreviewContextStateView with Draft/Published target status and Retry or Loading Preview instead of migration-required copy. The status bar continues to expose Core provenance and version capability status.

items.label: Keep preview readiness gated on fresh Core envelopes and explicit preview context availability.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor tests prove preview cannot look ready when backend/core status is unavailable or partial.
items.verificationNote: EditorShell now uses canShowPreviewTestInput, requiring core.envelope.status === "fresh", exact Preview target ready status, and initialized projection/Form/JSON state before rendering PreviewTestInputView. Tests guard the unavailable/checking fixture path and the fresh-core source condition.

items.label: Run the Editor verification gate after any honesty change.
items.evidenceTarget: `npm run check` or focused equivalent plus affected browser/component tests pass in the Editor repository.
items.verificationNote: Focused Editor regression checks passed with 7 test files and 39 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged main npm run check both passed with 77 test files, 283 tests, and build; the existing Vite chunk-size warning remained.
